Houthis Attack Yemen Presidential Palace; Saudi Facilities Targeted

The Houthi group claimed responsibility for a missile strike on the presidential palace in Aden, Yemen, which resulted in at least two deaths. Yemen's information minister stated that the prime minister and other ministers present at al-Maashiq Palace were unharmed. The Houthis also reportedly targeted Saudi oil facilities. The conflict in Yemen, which has been ongoing since July, saw a resurgence with this attack.
